english.note: Use 裝置 as the all-purpose technical noun for a purpose-built device or piece of hardware.
Use this when the mechanism is being treated as a device or apparatus rather than focusing on its internal parts.

examples.english: This device can automatically regulate the room temperature.
examples.traditional: 呢個裝置可以自動調節室內溫度。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zong1 zi3 ho2 ji5 zi6 dung6 tiu4 zit3 sat1 noi6 wan1 dou6

examples.english: The safety mechanism automatically stops the machine when it detects someone approaching.
examples.traditional: 個安全裝置一感應到有人行近就會自動停機。
